predict.question: In your 30-minute study session, each 4-minute chunk of work needs 6 minutes of logging to earn its reward. How many minutes of work do you complete?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: Punished by Rewards challenges the assumption that incentives reliably improve performance.
modelBoundary: Brief logging permits {A}; detailed logging {B}. Monitoring consumes time even before any motivational response is considered.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Actual schemes may create benefits that outweigh administration; this model does not estimate them.
